basis: Only compared threshold that flagged every documented IMS endpoint bearing and gave at least 60 minutes of descriptive lead on IMS and KAIST development trajectories
reference: Per-channel median of first 100 IMS records or first 10 KAIST/UNSW records; early reference health unverified
gap_reset: IMS: 900 seconds; KAIST: 5400 seconds; UNSW elapsed-time gaps unresolved
quality_policy: KAIST uses kaist-development-v1; IMS and UNSW native inputs require finite values
bearing_alert: Either physical vibration channel independently satisfies persistence; never count channels as independent bearings
known_concern: Flags additional IMS bearings without documented endpoint failures; these are unlabeled alerts, not proven false positives
